events.text: A living miniature tennis club. People share the space around the court.
Select Leo. His actual state and available actions appear beside him.
Both players walk to the court. The same club becomes a match.
The camera moves into the court for Championship tennis.
Space starts the serve. The racket releases the ball at contact.
Preparing swings before the bounce keeps the rally going. Contact remains physical.
Return to the same club, with the previous camera and pause state restored.
